regime: Mixed and diverging. NQ stays short below a falling stop while ES reclaimed its stop, so the index split is back on. Volatility eased a touch on NQ but the tape was two-sided. Gold broke to fresh highs and crude held firm. Normal to reduced risk into Jackson Hole week.
summary: Choppy Friday, and the indices split again. NQ never got back above its 29,518 stop, dipped to 29,220, then bounced to close 29,370, a third straight day under a falling stop. ES did the opposite and reclaimed its stop, closing 7,687.5 back on the long side, so the NQ versus ES divergence is back on after one day of alignment. Gold was the story, up 1.9% to a fresh 4,626.9 close with a new 4,654 high, well above its rising stop. Crude held firm near 87, closing 86.65 above its stop. NQ volatility eased a touch, hourly ATR near 83 versus 105 Thursday, but the tape stayed two-sided into the weekend and Jackson Hole week.
psychology: A failed breakdown can trap you. NQ sliced below its opening range and tagged 29,220, then snapped right back into the range and squeezed to 29,488. If you shorted the first break and married it, the reversal hurt. On a choppy pre-event Friday, treat the first break with suspicion and wait for acceptance, meaning two hourly closes beyond the level, before you lean on it.

risk.sizing: NQ volatility eased a bit but stays elevated, so keep sizing off the wider ATR. The indices disagree again, NQ short and ES long, which lowers conviction on any single index trend. Favor patience over forcing a directional trade.
risk.openRisk: Gold is extended after a 1.9% up day to fresh highs, so chasing late carries reversal risk. Respect a stop reclaim on NQ at 29,518 and a stop loss on ES at 7,674.
risk.note: Friday's flash PMIs were the last scheduled data. The next session is Monday Aug 24 with a quiet data start. The Jackson Hole symposium runs Aug 27 to 29 and is the week's main event. Not financial advice.
